newsitem.title: GERMANY: German office criticises France Telecom pay-out.
newsitem.headline: German office criticises France Telecom pay-out.

text.p: The German statistics office criticised on Friday the decision by the European statistics office to approve a 37.5 billion franc ($7.32 billion) payment by France Telecom to the French government.
The European Commission said on Thursday it would allow France to include the transfer from the telecom operator to government funds in a move which allows France to reduce its 1997 budget deficit.

However, German representatives had sought a budgetarily neutral means of payment at a recent meeting of the organisation of European statistics offices (Eurostat), the German federal statistics office said in a statement.
The German statistics office said it had proposed that the payment be made as a pre-payment into the state pension scheme.
In following years, this payment could be reduced by the amount which France Telecom would have to pay for the pensions of its former employees.
The statement went on to say that the proposal had been supported by many European nations.
